summary: This directory defines the core data models and configuration schemas for tracking project identity, file states, and workspace-level metadata within the system. It establishes the stable structures necessary for change detection and managing cached analysis artifacts across monorepo projects.
responsibilities: Define schemas for project workspace configuration
Model file state snapshots for change detection
Provide stable identities for projects within the workspace
Manage metadata and versioning for system components
relationships: The Project Workspace Manifest links specific project paths to unique internal IDs to support tracking in monorepo environments.
File Hash Snapshots capture the state of source files to facilitate system change detection.
The Workspace Manifest acts as the central reference for both project configuration and associated analysis artifacts.
designDecisions: Use of strict interfaces for defining system-wide data structures
Decoupling of filesystem state from internal project identity
Immutable structure representation for snapshot persistence
